title: An opt-in already cancelled still posts a cancel; the control can keep showing an erased opt-in
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: cancelReminders returns at once unless the opt-in is active, so an already-cancelled or erased opt-in (token '') posts no cancel, gets no 400 and counts nothing; the control also re-renders on hr:remote-changed (REMOTE_CHANGED_EVENT, as src/lib/lpa-unit.ts does), so another device's choice merged in shows (US-17 AC17). Tests: reminders.test.ts table rows 7-8; reminders-control.test.tsx 'another device turning reminders off, merged in'. Was: standalone/reminders.ts:388-391 cancelReminders checks only that an opt-in exists, so a cancelled one (an erased file carries token '') still posts a cancel with an empty token. And reminders-control.tsx re-renders only on hr:reminders-changed, so after another device's erase it can keep showing Turn off and the old address until something else re-renders it. Found by the PR 1664 adversary
